grammar_tips.title: Nominalization in Academic Writing
grammar_tips.explanation: Use nouns instead of verbs to sound more formal. E.g., 'The analysis of data' instead of 'Analyzing data.'

grammar_tips.title: Reporting Verbs
grammar_tips.explanation: Use verbs like 'suggests,' 'indicates,' and 'demonstrates' to report findings. Example: 'The study suggests that...'

Implications of this research may influence future studies.
